objectives.text: Add Spring Boot Actuator and read the aggregate status from /actuator/health, then enable component visibility with management.endpoint.health.show-components (component and detail visibility default to never; expose them only to trusted callers) and read the database health contributor's status
Expose only the endpoints you need over HTTP and explain why other Actuator endpoints stay unexposed by default
Explain how liveness and readiness health groups are used by a platform that restarts or routes traffic to the service
